_comment: Tests Ryde Health node 2c complaint intake: MSK complaint triggers style question, ambiguous complaint handled, non-MSK caller handled with out-of-scope response.

scenarios.name: Clear MSK complaint triggers qualifying style question

history.content: I've been getting really bad lower back pain, it's been going on for about two months

Oh, that's not ideal — you've come to the right place. Just to point you in the right direction, are you after something more hands-on — like joint work and manual therapy to get things moving and reduce the pain directly? Or would you prefer more of a rehab and exercise focus, understanding what's causing it and building strength so it doesn't keep coming back?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's prior response asked the style question (structural vs rehab) without routing or calling any tool. FAIL if the agent called smart_voice_agent before asking the qualifying question, or routed to booking immediately.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous complaint with no clear MSK category still extracts complaint and asks style

history.content: I've just been feeling really run down and achy all over, like my whole body is stiff

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent classifies as whole-body/systemic MSK, sets eligible categories to Physiotherapy, Osteopathy, Acupuncture, and asks a style qualifying question (or needle check if acupuncture is dominant). FAIL if agent says the complaint is out of scope or routes immediately to smart_voice_agent without qualifying.

scenarios.name: Caller pivots to cancel during intake — routes to cancel_intent with a filler phrase

history.content: My knee has been bothering me after my run last week
Oh, that's not ideal — you've come to the right place. Are you after something more hands-on, or more of a rehab and strengthening focus?
Actually, never mind — can I cancel my appointment instead?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent', in the same turn (per the ESCAPE ROUTE OUTPUT FORMAT). FAIL if agent continues the intake flow, asks a qualifying question before routing, omits the filler phrase, or speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase.

scenarios.name: Plain pricing question during intake routes to PRICING QUERY, not INFO PIVOT

history.content: I've been getting really bad lower back pain, it's been going on for about two months

Oh, that's not ideal — you've come to the right place. Are you after something more hands-on — joint work and manual therapy to get things moving and reduce the pain directly? Or more of a rehab and exercise focus, understanding what's causing it and building strength so it doesn't keep coming back?
Actually, before I decide — how much does a physio session cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set and calls universal_router intent='get_service_price' (the system prompt's PRICING QUERY path — stays in this node, does not eject to info_pivot). FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' for a plain, uncombined pricing question.

scenarios.name: Combined price+duration question still routes to INFO PIVOT (regression guard)

history.content: How much does a physio session cost and how long does it run?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' (system prompt's COMBINED ASK SCOPED EXCEPTION routes same-turn price+duration asks to info_pivot/Node 8). FAIL if agent calls get_service_price directly for this combined ask, or fails to call any tool.

scenarios.name: Caller only wants to check an existing appointment — routes to details, not cancel_intent

history.content: Hi, can you just check what time my appointment is for on Thursday?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says "Checking that now, one moment." and calls universal_router intent='details' (system prompt's PATIENT APPOINTMENT LOOKUP, PHASE A). FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' for a pure check/confirm request with no cancel or reschedule language.

scenarios.name: Genuine cancel request still routes to cancel_intent (regression guard)

history.content: I've been getting shoulder pain from gardening
Oh, that's not ideal — you've come to the right place. Are you after something more hands-on, or more of a rehab and strengthening focus?
Actually, forget it — I need to cancel my appointment for Friday instead

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent'. FAIL if agent routes to intent='details' or continues the complaint-intake flow instead of escaping.

scenarios.name: STEP 6-PRIME reorder surfaces a true DOC 2 focus match ranked below due_rank 3 (main flow, not a who's-best query)

history.content: I hurt my knee playing tennis a couple of weeks ago
Oh, that's not ideal — you've come to the right place. Are you after something more hands-on, or more of a rehab and exercise focus?
Definitely the rehab and exercise side, I want to build it back up properly
Do you have a preference for seeing a male or female practitioner, or no preference?
No preference. I'd like to come in this week if possible.
Let me just have a look here for you.

TOOL RESULT (smart_voice_agent, intent=recommend_availability): {"success": true, "session_id": "sess_test", "recommendations": [{"practitioner_id": "p_alex", "practitioner_name": "Alex Donald", "appointment_type_id": "at_physio_initial", "appointment_type": "Physiotherapy Initial Consultation", "due_rank": 1, "available_slots": [{"date": "2026-09-16", "day_of_week": "Wednesday", "slot_groups": {"morning": ["9:00 AM"]}}], "earliest_slot": {"date": "2026-09-16", "time": "9:00 AM"}}, {"practitioner_id": "p_mia", "practitioner_name": "Mia Navratil", "appointment_type_id": "at_physio_initial", "appointment_type": "Physiotherapy Initial Consultation", "due_rank": 2, "available_slots": [{"date": "2026-09-17", "day_of_week": "Thursday", "slot_groups": {"afternoon": ["2:00 PM"]}}], "earliest_slot": {"date": "2026-09-17", "time": "2:00 PM"}}, {"practitioner_id": "p_parinaz", "practitioner_name": "Parinaz Kheirandish", "appointment_type_id": "at_physio_initial", "appointment_type": "Physiotherapy Initial Consultation", "due_rank": 3, "available_slots": [{"date": "2026-09-16", "day_of_week": "Wednesday", "slot_groups": {"afternoon": ["3:00 PM"]}}], "earliest_slot": {"date": "2026-09-16", "time": "3:00 PM"}}, {"practitioner_id": "p_cat", "practitioner_name": "Catherine Miller", "appointment_type_id": "at_physio_initial", "appointment_type": "Physiotherapy Initial Consultation", "due_rank": 4, "available_slots": [{"date": "2026-09-16", "day_of_week": "Wednesday", "slot_groups": {"morning": ["10:30 AM"]}}], "earliest_slot": {"date": "2026-09-16", "time": "10:30 AM"}}], "first_available": {"practitioner_id": "p_alex", "practitioner_name": "Alex Donald", "date": "2026-09-16", "time": "9:00 AM"}}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's next turn presents Catherine Miller (due_rank 4 in the tool result, but the only one of the four whose DOC 2 focus list — 'lower limb injuries, knee and hip' — directly matches the knee complaint) as the recommended practitioner, with her 10:30 AM Wednesday slot, and a justification connecting her modality to the knee complaint. FAIL if the agent presents Alex Donald (due_rank 1) or any practitioner other than Catherine Miller as the first offer, or if it presents Alex Donald's slot/first_available instead of Catherine Miller's — that would mean the reorder was not applied or the agent used the pre-reorder top-level first_available instead of stored_recommendations[0].

scenarios.name: Who's-best query with no DOC 2 focus match among returned candidates falls back to due_rank order, not a false no-availability response

history.content: Who's best for general deconditioning after being sick for a few weeks?
Let me just have a look here for you.

TOOL RESULT (smart_voice_agent, intent=recommend_availability): {"success": true, "session_id": "sess_test2", "recommendations": [{"practitioner_id": "p_scott", "practitioner_name": "Scott Lyon", "appointment_type_id": "at_pilates_initial", "appointment_type": "Clinical Pilates Initial", "due_rank": 1, "available_slots": [{"date": "2026-09-16", "day_of_week": "Wednesday", "slot_groups": {"morning": ["8:00 AM"]}}], "earliest_slot": {"date": "2026-09-16", "time": "8:00 AM"}}, {"practitioner_id": "p_jordan", "practitioner_name": "Jordan Suen", "appointment_type_id": "at_chiro_initial", "appointment_type": "Chiropractic Initial", "due_rank": 2, "available_slots": [{"date": "2026-09-17", "day_of_week": "Thursday", "slot_groups": {"afternoon": ["1:00 PM"]}}], "earliest_slot": {"date": "2026-09-17", "time": "1:00 PM"}}], "first_available": {"practitioner_id": "p_scott", "practitioner_name": "Scott Lyon", "date": "2026-09-16", "time": "8:00 AM"}}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent presents Scott Lyon (due_rank 1 — Scott Lyon's DOC 2 prefer_not is 'purely passive presentations, general deconditioning in non-active patients' which is an exclusion match here, so RULE 1 EXCLUSION should actually remove him and the agent should present Jordan Suen instead, who has no exclusion for this complaint) or otherwise gives a real recommendation with a real time slot and asks a closing question. FAIL if the agent says there is no availability, or refuses to answer the who's-best question, when the tool result clearly contains bookable slots — RULE 4 (no focus match -> due_rank default, not a failure) must produce a real recommendation here, and the RULE 1 exclusion for Scott Lyon must still be honored.
